text:
The first photo shows a lasagna portion of roughly 250 g on a plate. The cone-shaped wrapper holds something small, probably a cone-wrapped item like a drink straw or cutlery; it ends up crumpled in the second photo, and something blue is visible next to it, so it may be a wrapped utensil. The glass of water has no calories.

The plate in the second photo has only sauce and cheese residue left, so nearly all of the lasagna was eaten. I'll assume about 235 g was eaten out of roughly 250 g.

Lasagna bolognese runs about 150 kcal per 100 g, so 235 g comes to roughly 350 kcal.

{"kcal": 350, "mass_g": 235}
